amazon-ad-tag: Pinned browser and official server-template profiles, not an exhaustive receiver specification. All new checks are warnings.
The server template accepts opaque tag identities; UUID grammar is checked only when eventSource is amzn.js. Custom event names remain open within the producer length bound.
Item entries remain open objects. No Amazon Ads Conversions API product schema, positive value requirement or currency whitelist is borrowed.
Amazon consent fields receive structural checks. Consent validity, delivery, ownership, attribution, token authenticity and deduplication require external context.
amazon-ad-tag-regional: Same source-scoped checks as the main Amazon Ad Tag collector, limited to the exact EU and FE host-route combinations.
The NA route is not inferred on regional hosts. Arbitrary neighboring routes remain explicitly uncontracted.
Receiver acceptance, regional eligibility and account configuration remain external.
adroll-image: Only the documented d.adroll.com/ipixel advertiser/pixel audience route is contracted.
Advertiser, pixel and segment identities are opaque. No fixed identity length is inferred.
Facebook image aliases, modern v2 runtime bundles, other collectors, account ownership and delivery are outside this documented image profile.
adroll-pixel: Pinned public legacy roundtrip.js v1 profile. Producer checks remain warnings, and modern advertiser-specific v2 bundles are not claimed.
The source emits USC for its dollar convenience input. USC is preserved without incorrectly applying the ISO currency registry.
Custom data uses legacy escape with percent-u and Latin-1 representations. It remains opaque; the strict UTF-8 nested-query decoder is not applied.
Cookie presence, audience membership, identity ownership, consent correctness, conversion attribution and delivery need external context.
reddit: The pinned SDK emits POST form requests to /rp and GET fallbacks to /rp.gif. Optional metadata and matching-field checks remain advisory.
Documentation allows any UTF-8 custom name through 64 characters. The current SDK truncates at 128 code points. The documented 64-character contract is retained and newline handling is fixed.
Product prices and quantities retain native numbers or numeric strings. Fractional quantities, negative values, optional products and future properties remain open.
Hash syntax does not prove normalization or correct identity. SDK fallback trimming can omit metadata. CAPI deduplication, consent, delivery and account identity need external context.
outbrain: The browser SDK sends marketerId, including comma-joined marketers, and can fall back to POST sendBeacon with query parameters.
Browser identities prevent the S2S GET constraint from applying to browser beacons carrying ob_click_id. S2S-only requests retain GET.
The current SDK currency list omits MYR while official documentation includes it. The documented currency list, including MYR, remains authoritative.
The SDK logs event validation problems but still dispatches. Browser naming and missing-currency advice therefore remain warnings, not receiver rejection claims.
Cookie authenticity, identity ownership, conversion deduplication, destination support and delivery require external context.

producer_controls.setup: Unmodified pinned SDKs executed in isolated Chromium on example.test. fetch, sendBeacon, images and scripts are intercepted. The unmodified Amazon server-template function executes with stubbed GTM APIs. All identities and commerce inputs are synthetic.

deferred_research.reason: Public generic SDK access returned HTTP 403; no collector requirements inferred.
The generic loader defers to account-specific runtime bundles; existing coverage is retained without guessing a collector schema.
The prior review found a proprietary non-JSON nested action grammar. No unrelated Retail Media API constraints are borrowed.

privacy: Only synthetic fixtures and public source metadata are committed. Public SDK copies and private corpus records remain outside the product repository.
